usefulness.evidence: The six-step state application mechanism plus two practical tables completes the reader task beyond a directory link. It separates filing, proof, interview, notice and recertification, and routes urgent need to conditional expedited review.

sourceAndAssumptions.evidence: USDA/USAGov sources support the application sequence and timing. The packet was honestly narrowed after removing the unsupported blanket third-party-form assertion; the original packet is preserved. No national mandatory document list or national phone-filing claim is invented.

conditionsAndCounterexample.evidence: State submission channels and requested proof vary; expedited7-day processing is conditional, ordinary timing is generally30days, and the agency determines eligibility/award. The work/noncitizen notice is explicitly still being updated. This is reported process synthesis, so no artificial numerical experiment is needed.

renderedConsistency.evidence: The final guide preserves the six steps, preparation/status tables, exact source links and restricted-food-benefit budget distinction. Own browser checked both tables, seven contents anchors and FAQ behavior, with fresh intact date paragraphs; final snapshot/review bind the exact result.

localExclusions.evidence: Operator process voice uses the recorded tee-up exemption. No SSN/application collection, case access, personal enrollment/test experience or professional credential is claimed. Unrelated case matches were rejected; state agencies remain the decision makers.
